description: ccp15 vectors for SF EMA load_factor hash_32(FNV-1a32 basis 0x811c9dc5 per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:123) congestion control with independent external arithmetic oracle (math based, no code under test).

vectors.name: density_estimate_high
vectors.description: adaptive_sf_select with density > 10 forces SF bump to MIN(12, SF+2) per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:2a.7. SF10+2→12 with density=15, utilization=100.

vectors.name: sf_selection_low_density_capacity
vectors.description: adaptive_sf_select with density < 5 and SNR_EMA > 8 decreases SF to MAX(7, SF-1) per spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:2a.7. SF10-1→9 with density=3, SNR_EMA=10.
